Your wallet can now give each app its own NWC connection.

Nostr WoT 0.8.3 adds connection management for Nostr WoT LNbits wallets: a name, spending limit per 24 hours and expiry for each connection. Copy its pairing string or QR code, review active connections and budget usage, and revoke access from Wallet Settings.

One wallet, separate allowances.

We added this for people who want to use their existing wallet across NWC-compatible apps. Each connection can pay invoices and look up payments; it does not expose balance or transaction history. Apps requiring those methods may have limited functionality.

Locking the extension does not revoke an app connection. Revoke it when you want access to stop. The guide walks through setup and management in seven languages.

Version 0.8.3 is available on GitHub. Browser-store publication is separate.

nostr:
Nostr WoT 0.8.3: separate NWC connections for your apps, using your existing Nostr WoT LNbits wallet.

Open Wallet Settings, then App connections. Name each connection, set a spending limit per 24 hours and an expiry, and copy its string or QR code into an NWC-compatible app. Review active connections and budget usage, or revoke access from the same screen.

Connections allow payments, payment lookup and wallet information, without balance or history access. Apps requiring more methods may have limited functionality. Locking the extension does not revoke a connection.

The seven-language guide covers setup, limits and revocation. Version 0.8.3 is downloadable from GitHub; browser-store publication is separate.
